lines.speaker: A

lines.text: Our train is not coming.

lines.text: I cannot wait that long.

lines.text: Can we go there at seven?

lines.text: I will ask the person at the desk.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɪl ˈask ðə pˈɜːsən at ðə dˈɛsk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I borrow this book?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you have a library card?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It is at home.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You can read the book here today.
lines.ipa: /juː kan ɹˈiːd ðə bˈʊk hˈiə tədˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Which page is our homework on?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Page twenty, the second question.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do we write in the book?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, use your blue notebook.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Shall we study after lunch?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I have football at two.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What about tomorrow morning?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That works. Meet me at the library.
lines.ipa: /ðat wˈɜːks mˈiːt mˌiː at ðə lˈaɪbɹəɹi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My work is not finished.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: When do you have to give it in?
lines.ipa: /wˌɛn dˈuː juː hav tə ɡˈɪv ɪt ˈɪn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This afternoon, but my computer is broken.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs ˌaftənˈuːn bˌʌt maɪ kəmpjˈuːtəɹ ɪz bɹˈəʊkən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Tell the teacher before the lesson.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What does this red mark mean?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You need a full stop here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And this word has two letters wrong?
lines.ipa: /and ðɪs wˈɜːd hɐz tˈuː lˈɛtəz ɹˈɒŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Look at the example on the board.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs lˈʊk at ðɪ ɛɡzˈampəl ɒnðə bˈɔːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I want to learn to draw.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There is a class on Saturday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is it for new students?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. You do not need to bring anything.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs juː duːnˌɒt nˈiːd tə bɹˈɪŋ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can you listen to my short talk?
lines.ipa: /kan juː lˈɪsən tə maɪ ʃˈɔːt tˈɔːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure. I will sit at the back.
lines.ipa: /ʃˈʊə aɪ wɪl sˈɪt at ðə bˈak/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Tell me if I speak too quietly.
lines.ipa: /tˈɛl mˌiː ɪf aɪ spˈiːk tˈuː kwˈaɪətli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I cannot hear you yet. Try again.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kˈanɒt hˈiə juː jˈɛt tɹˈaɪ ɐɡˈɛn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I cannot see the lesson link.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is in the first email.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh, I opened the second one.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There it is. Click the blue words.
lines.ipa: /ðeəɹ ɪt ˈɪz klˈɪk ðə blˈuː wˈɜːdz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Who wrote this book?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The name is on the front.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can only see the title.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Turn it over. The writer is on the back.
lines.ipa: /tˈɜːn ɪt ˈəʊvə ðə ɹˈaɪtəɹ ɪz ɒnðə bˈak/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There is a test on Thursday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I thought it was next week.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, look at the class calendar.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then I had better start reading today.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn aɪ had bˈɛtə stˈɑːt ɹˈiːdɪŋ tədˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What time is the meeting?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: At half past ten.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will it be in the big room?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, we are using the room upstairs.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ wiː ɑː jˈuːzɪŋ ðə ɹˈuːm ʌpstˈeəz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Who is doing the front window?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can do it after lunch.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then I will clean the tables.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The cloths are under the counter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you in the office tomorrow?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, I am working at home.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I call you at eleven?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use my work number, please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I do not know how to do this.
lines.ipa: /aɪ duːnˌɒt nˈəʊ hˌaʊ tə dˈuː ðˈɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Come here and I will show you.
lines.ipa: /kˈʌm hˈiə and aɪ wɪl ʃˈəʊ juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Which button do I press first?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The green one, not the red one.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɡɹˈiːn wˌɒn nˌɒt ðə ɹˈɛd wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will this be ready on Friday?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I still need one more day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Would Saturday morning be enough?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. I can bring it before ten.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs aɪ kan bɹˈɪŋ ɪt bɪfˌɔː tˈɛn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is that the new person by the door?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðatðə njˈuː pˈɜːsən baɪ ðə dˈɔː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, her name is Maya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I will show her where we sit.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɪl ʃˈəʊ hɜː wˌeə wiː sˈɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thanks. Her desk is beside yours.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you take my notebook?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I thought it was the office one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My name is inside the cover.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am sorry. Here it is.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How many boxes did we send?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Twenty in the morning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And ten more after lunch?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Put thirty on the form.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This shelf is hard to reach.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could we move the heavy bags lower down?
lines.ipa: /kʊd wiː mˈuːv ðə hˈɛvi bˈaɡz lˈəʊə dˈaʊn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That would make my job easier.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let us ask before we change it.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt ˌʌs ˈask bɪfˌɔː wiː tʃˈeɪndʒ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I am away next week.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Who will answer your phone?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Liam will, but he needs my notes.
lines.ipa: /lˈiːəm wˈɪl bˌʌt hiː nˈiːdz maɪ nˈəʊts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Leave them on his desk this afternoon.
lines.ipa: /lˈiːv ðˌɛm ˌɒn hɪz dˈɛsk ðɪs ˌaftənˈuːn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I cannot remember my password.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you write it in that book?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː ɹˈaɪt ɪt ɪn ðat bˈʊk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, that is my old one.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use the account help page to change it.
lines.ipa: /jˈuːs ðɪ ɐkˈaʊnt hˈɛlp pˈeɪdʒ tə tʃˈeɪndʒ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can you open the photo I sent?
lines.ipa: /kan juː ˈəʊpən ðə fˈəʊtəʊ aɪ sˈɛnt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It asks me to sign in.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used the wrong link.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Send the new link to my work email.
lines.ipa: /sˈɛnd ðə njˈuː lˈɪŋk tə maɪ wˈɜːk ˈiːmeɪl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where are your holiday photos?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: On this drive, and on my computer.
lines.ipa: /ˌɒn ðɪs dɹˈaɪv and ˌɒn maɪ kəmpjˈuːtə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So you have two copies?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. I do not want to lose them.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs aɪ duːnˌɒt wˈɒnt tə lˈuːz ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your phone keeps making a noise.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is the group chat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can you turn the sound off?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I will. We are trying to watch the film.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wˈɪl wiː ɑː tɹˈaɪɪŋ tə wˈɒtʃ ðə fˈɪlm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My app looks different today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There was an update last night.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where is the search button now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: At the top, next to your name.
lines.ipa: /at ðə tˈɒp nˈɛkst tə jɔː nˈeɪm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The internet is slow in here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It works well in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can we do the call there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, the table is clear.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why does this app want my photos?
lines.ipa: /wˌaɪ dˈʌz ðɪs ˈap wˈɒnt maɪ fˈəʊtəʊz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I do not know. Does it need them?
lines.ipa: /aɪ duːnˌɒt nˈəʊ dˈʌz ɪt nˈiːd ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I only use it to check the weather.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈəʊnli jˈuːz ɪt tə tʃˈɛk ðə wˈɛðə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then leave that setting off.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These words are too small.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You can make them bigger.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will that change the photos too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. Look at the text setting here.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ lˈʊk at ðə tˈɛkst sˈɛtɪŋ hˈiə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The new tool gave me a wrong date.
lines.ipa: /ðə njˈuː tˈuːl ɡˈeɪv mˌiː ɐ ɹˈɒŋ dˈeɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Where did you check it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: On the school website.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use the date from the school, then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I do not use this service now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are you still paying for it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, every month.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Look for the stop option in your account.
lines.ipa: /lˈʊk fəðə stˈɒp ˈɒpʃən ɪn jɔːɹ ɐkˈaʊnt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Which bin does this bottle go in?
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ bˈɪn dˈʌz ðɪs bˈɒtəl ɡˌəʊ ˈɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The green one is for glass.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It is a plastic bottle.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then use the blue bin beside it.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn jˈuːz ðə blˈuː bˈɪn bɪsˈaɪd ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That tap is still running.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Can you turn it off?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I tried, but it will not stop.
lines.ipa: /aɪ tɹˈaɪd bˌʌt ɪt wɪl nˌɒt stˈɒp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let us tell someone in the office.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where shall we put this tree?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not too close to the wall.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will it get enough sun here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, and there is room for it to grow.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs and ðeəɹ ɪz ɹˈuːm fɔːɹ ɪt tə ɡɹˈəʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do we need gloves for the park clean?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː wiː nˈiːd ɡlˈʌvz fəðə pˈɑːk klˈiːn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There are some in this box.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These are much too big for me.
lines.ipa: /ðiːz ɑː mˈʌtʃ tˈuː bˈɪɡ fɔː mˌiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Try the pair with yellow fingers.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you selling things at the market?
lines.ipa: /ɑː juː sˈɛlɪŋ θˈɪŋz at ðə mˈɑːkɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Some old books and a few plants.
lines.ipa: /sˌʌm ˈəʊld bˈʊks and ɐ fjˈuː plˈants/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I help at your table?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Come before nine to set up.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs kˈʌm bɪfˌɔː nˈaɪn tə sˈɛt ˈʌp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Whose tools are on this shelf?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They are for everyone in our street.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ɑː fɔːɹ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn ɪn ˌaʊə stɹˈiːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: May I borrow the small spade?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Write your name in the book first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do we need all these paper cups?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː wiː nˈiːd ˈɔːl ðiːz pˈeɪpə kˈʌps/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We have some proper cups in the kitchen.
lines.ipa: /wiː hav sˌʌm pɹˈɒpə kˈʌps ɪnðə kˈɪtʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can bring them out.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Count them first. There are twelve guests.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why do you not ride to school?
lines.ipa: /wˌaɪ dˈuː juː nˌɒt ɹˈaɪd tə skˈuːl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The road by the bridge is busy.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈəʊd baɪ ðə bɹˈɪdʒ ɪz bˈɪzi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is there another way?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There is a path through the park.
lines.ipa: /ðeəɹ ɪz ɐ pˈaθ θɹuː ðə pˈɑːk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What is this form for?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: People can say what the park needs.
lines.ipa: /pˈiːpəl kan sˈeɪ wɒt ðə pˈɑːk nˈiːdz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I ask for more seats?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Write it in the empty box.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We have money for one new thing.
lines.ipa: /wiː hav mˈʌni fɔː wˈɒn njˈuː θˈɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I would like a bench.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The children want a football goal.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let us ask the rest of the street.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt ˌʌs ˈask ðə ɹˈɛst ɒvðə stɹˈiːt/
